{%- comment -%}
  The generated part of llms-full.txt (TRANSLATION.md 4.12): every live app, then audience pages, guides, journal
  answers and comparison pages, in the language of the including page (root /llms-full.txt: English; each
  /<code>/llms-full.txt: that language). Facts come from the master app documents and the catalog; words from the
  page in that language; labels from _data/i18n/<lang>.yml `lf`. The including stub writes the preamble.
{%- endcomment -%}
